card.name: The word other before drug class names
card.fires_on: The word "other" (sometimes "a" or "th") right after a named drug, as in "as with other...", where the next words name a drug class such as sulfonylureas, fibrates or antiarrhythmics.

modes.label: As with other (class)
modes.description: "other" in comparisons that extend a named drug's effects to its drug class.
modes.example: An overdosage of glimepiride tablets, as with<< other>> sulfonylureas, can produce

modes.label: Drug and other drugs in class
modes.description: "other" after "and" or "of" when a named drug is grouped with its class members.
modes.example: with fluvastatin capsules and<< other>> drugs in this class.

modes.label: Start of a class name
modes.description: The word "a" or the start of a drug class name, just before the class is named.
modes.example: contains dorzolamide,<< a>> sulfonamide; and although administered top

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward word-piece continuations and away from a few unrelated pieces, with no clear drug meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the word "other" when a label says a drug acts like others in its class.
